title: NSRW: fifteen scalar enclosures cross-checked with a second backend
summary: The exact-rational Fraction producer and mpmath 1.3.0 interval checker use different arithmetic implementations and expression forms. Fifteen containment checks pass. The same operator executed both paths; this is a second-backend scalar cross-check, not external reproduction or a numerical J certificate.
findings: 15/15 complete interval containments; no midpoint-only comparison
Working precision: 320, 448 and 704 bits for 128, 256 and 512 fractional-bit records
Direct exponential differences check the producer's factored expm1 quantities
Input raw SHA-256 and portable LF SHA-256 are recorded separately
Canonical executable code and architecture remain in NSRW; Ledger exposes the execution record
